name: AppsPlus Dynamic QR Manager
author: dimasappsplus

sections.description:
AppsPlus Dynamic QR Manager is a dynamic QR code generator and QR redirect manager for WordPress. Create dynamic QR codes using your own WordPress domain and change their destination URLs without replacing or reprinting the QR code.

Create a QR code once and manage its redirect destination from your WordPress dashboard. Each QR code can be enabled or disabled, downloaded as a PNG file, and used to track total scans.

The WordPress.org plugin is free and fully functional. It does not require an account, license key, payment, subscription, or external QR code service.

Features included in this plugin:

  • Create and manage multiple dynamic QR codes.
  • Generate QR code redirects using your own WordPress domain.
  • Change a QR code’s destination URL without replacing or reprinting the QR code.
  • Enable or disable individual QR code redirects.
  • Download standard black-and-white QR codes as PNG files.
  • Track total scans for each dynamic QR code.
  • Keep QR redirect and scan data in your WordPress database.

A separately distributed commercial add-on is available from Apps Plus Software for organizations that want additional design, export, reporting, and commercial support capabilities. The add-on and its functionality are not included in this WordPress.org plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate AppsPlus Software Scan Redirect Manager.
  3. Open Scan Redirect in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a QR code and enter its destination URL.
  5. Download the PNG and use it where needed.
sections.faq:
What is a dynamic QR code?

A dynamic QR code uses a redirect URL instead of sending the visitor directly to the final destination. This allows you to change the destination URL later without replacing or reprinting the QR code.

Can I change a QR code destination after it has been printed?

Yes. The QR code points to a redirect URL on your WordPress site. You can change its destination later while continuing to use the same printed QR code.

Does this plugin generate dynamic QR codes in WordPress?

Yes. AppsPlus Software Scan Redirect Manager works as a dynamic QR code generator and QR redirect manager inside WordPress.

How many dynamic QR codes can I create?

The WordPress.org plugin does not impose a QR-code quota.

Can I track QR code scans?

Yes. The plugin tracks the total number of scans for each dynamic QR code.

Does this plugin require an account or license key?

No. The WordPress.org plugin works without an account, subscription, or license key.

Does the plugin use an external QR code or redirect service?

No. QR code generation, redirects, and scan totals are handled by the plugin on your WordPress site.

Is there a commercial add-on?

Yes. Apps Plus Software distributes a separate commercial add-on for additional capabilities. Its code is not included in this WordPress.org package.
